name: Grasshopper Bank
description: The Grasshopper Bank MCP server connects Claude to your banking data, enabling AI-powered access to account information, transactions, and other insights. Query balances, analyze spending patterns, retrieve transaction history, and surface financial trends — all through natural language. Purpose-built for Grasshopper Bank customers, this connector brings your banking data into Claude workflows without switching tools. Accelerate routine analysis, support financial decisions, and unlock deeper visibility into your banking operations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Grasshopper Bank to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Grasshopper Bank to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://grasshopper-mcp.prd.narmitech.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Grasshopper Bank MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grasshopper Bank provides these MCP tools: accounts_list, documents_list, external_accounts_list, products_list, scheduled_transfers_list, and transactions_list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Grasshopper Bank?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Grasshopper Bank in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Grasshopper Bank MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grasshopper Bank requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Grasshopper Bank is developed by Grasshopper Bank. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
